name: laya-compaction
description: Verbatim Laya-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

url.title: Laya server URL
url.description: Base URL of a laya-serve server (remote mode). Leave unset to use LAYA_URL; when both are unset the plugin starts a shared local laya-serve (needs uv).

apiKey.title: Laya server API key
apiKey.description: Bearer key of the laya-serve server. Leave unset to use LAYA_API_KEY.

model.title: Laya checkpoint
model.description: Remote mode: checkpoint name sent to laya-serve (english, multilingual, typed-decisions). Leave unset to use LAYA_MODEL or let the server choose. Local mode always uses multilingual.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Laya probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxLen.title: Laya token window
maxLen.description: Token window the state and one question share, sent as max_len (up to 8192 on multilingual). Wider means more context and slower questions.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Laya state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Laya request. Defaults to maxLen minus 112.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Laya request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Laya request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Laya decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.
